§7.3.5 Margin Banners

📄 Page rule — applied from the page alone

text-margin-banners · text marks layout

✅ Normative

Rotated text printed along a side margin MUST be rendered once, as a furniture block of its own outside the body flow, with its words kept — branding included. It MUST NOT be tagged as a watermark unless it actually overlays the content.

Text printed rotated along the page margin, outside the content area: an archive stamp, a brand line, a firm mark. Unlike a watermark§7.3.13 it does not overlap the content, and unlike a page header it is not in the top or bottom margin.

 U │                                         │
 S │  Overview of Risk Ranking Symbols       │
   │                                         │
 E │  One way to rank environmental impacts  │
 P │  …                                      │
 A │                                         │

Requirements

  • The words MUST be kept. Some banners are document metadata — "US EPA ARCHIVE DOCUMENT" tells the reader the document is superseded, the same kind of fact "DRAFT" carries. Branding is printed text too, and MUST NOT be dropped as decoration.
  • The banner MUST be one block of its own, rendered once on the page, and MUST NOT be spliced into a body sentence, table or list.
  • The [watermark: …] marker MUST NOT be used for text that does not cross the content.
  • The rotation MUST NOT be described. The words are the content.
  • The samples place the banner at the start of its page's content.

✅ Sample — an archive stamp down the left margin


Source: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Specialty-Batch Chemical Manufacturing Industry — EMS Implementation Guide (Appendix D) (public domain)

"US EPA ARCHIVE DOCUMENT" printed vertically in a red band, full page height, beside an ordinary text-and-table page. The banner carries a fact about the document that appears nowhere else on it.

✅ Sample — a brand line on a slide

"PRECISION & MOTION" runs down a decorative band on the left of the slide. This is branding, but it is still printed text.

Expected Markdown

Interest-Bearing Debts

Term loan A EUR 4.10% 2026 640

Revolving credit facility SEK 3.60% 2028 210

Total interest-bearing debt 2,675

Weighted average cost of debt for the period was 3.9%, down from 4.2% in the prior year, reflecting the refinancing of Term loan A at a lower margin.
